name: What the desk did in reaction (the row: trigger → reaction → changed → could change → next)

note: The Stacks' grammar; served here, changes on the Stacks' word. A reaction's reach (is the part his, what hangs under it, is it a premise later parts build on) is three words from structure, never a score.
